receivers.name: SDRplay Demo
receivers.notes: SDRplay's own demonstration unit. Up to 8 users at once, first come first served, 15-minute sessions.

receivers.name: Baltic Lab
receivers.notes: 30-minute sessions. One person controls the radio at a time; others tune within their segment. The owner asks that antenna B stays selected with Bias-T on.

receivers.name: KI5ENW
receivers.notes: A long-running demo unit kept up by a former SDRplay team member. Login is on SDRplay's demo page.
